دبیرستان پسرانه‌ی دوره اول متوسطه در شیر: A private boys' lower-secondary school (grades 7 to 9) in Shiraz, Iran, since 2008. Every student has his own talents and interests. Instead of one model for everyone, Afarinesh builds several paths of learning and each student chooses his own.
از مدرسه‌ی زندگی تا پژوهش‌محوری: From a school for life to research-based learning
دبیرستان غیردولتی آفرینش مدرسه‌ای پسرانه: Afarinesh High School is a private boys' lower-secondary school on Narvan Street in Shiraz: a place for curious minds, where students' big ideas are taken seriously. The programme is built on variety, informed choice and attention to each student's differences. A student who takes part in something he cares about develops his talent for real and for good, which is why the research, art, language, culture and sport electives run for the whole school year.
کنار آموزش، سه مشاور تخصصی (تحصیلی، بالی: Alongside teaching, three specialist counsellors (academic, clinical and nutrition) work with students in the school itself.
همه‌ی دانش‌آموزان ورودی، همراه با والدین: Every new student has a specialist interview together with his parents, so that the school and the family get to know each other before the year begins.
دبیر متخصص هر درس: A specialist teacher for every subject
هر درس را دبیری با تحصیلات همان رشته درس: Each subject is taught by a teacher who studied that field; many hold a master's degree or a doctorate, and several have more than 30 years of teaching experience.
هر کلاس ۱۵ تا ۱۷ نفر؛ دبیر همه‌ی دانش‌آم: 15 to 17 students in each class: the teacher knows every student by name, has time for each one's questions and follows his progress closely.
ریاضی در دو درس حساب و هندسه؛ علوم در دو: Maths as two courses, arithmetic and geometry; science as two courses, physics–chemistry and biology–earth science.
مشاوره‌ی تحصیلی، بالینی و تغذیه در خود م: Academic, clinical and nutrition counselling in the school itself, for students and for their families.
چهار مرحله آزمون هماهنگ تستی و تشریحی در: Four school-wide exam rounds a year, multiple-choice and written, and the school's own practice books, so each student's progress is seen and followed through the year.
این مسیرها مقطعی و نمایشی نیستند؛ تا پای: These paths are not one-off shows: they run until the end of the year and each student chooses his own. That choice builds a sense of belonging and responsibility.
دانش‌آموز ایده‌ای را از طرح اولیه تا ساخ: Students take an idea from first sketch to a working build: they write programs, build robots and solve problems in teams. These classes run for the whole year.
از طراحی و مجسمه‌سازی تا گرافیک، معماری،: From drawing and sculpture to graphic design, architecture, khatam marquetry and film: each student chooses the art he likes and keeps at it all year.
انگلیسی در دوره‌های ترمی و فرانسه برای ع: English in term courses, and French for those who want it: classes separate from the school's language lessons, chosen by the student and running all year.
خواندن، نوشتن و گفت‌وگو درباره‌ی کتاب‌ها: Reading, writing and talking about books and Persian literature.
کلاس‌های ورزشی انتخابی که تا پایان سال ا: Sport electives that run for the whole year.
کارگاه‌هایی برای ساختن با دست، روی صحنه: Workshops for making things by hand, going on stage and learning skills that are useful in everyday life.

دبیرستان آفرینش چه مدرسه‌ای است و کجای ش: What kind of school is Afarinesh High School, and where in Shiraz is it?
دبیرستان غیردولتی آفرینش شیراز (که خیلی‌: Afarinesh High School, Shiraz (often called Afarinesh School or Afarinesh Private School) is a private, research-based boys' school for the first cycle of secondary education: grades 7, 8 and 9. Since 2008 it has been in Chenchene, on Narvan Street at the corner of Alley 14, Shiraz, and among the city's private schools it is known for classes of 15 to 17 students and for its research, art, language and sport electives.
هر دانش‌آموز از میان شاخه‌های پژوهشی، هن: Each student chooses the path he likes from the research, art, language, culture, sport and special strands. These classes are not one-offs; they run until the end of the school year.

کلاس‌ها ۱۵ تا ۱۷ نفره‌اند تا دبیر بتواند: Classes have 15 to 17 students, so the teacher can work with every student individually.
